name: 27107 · Winston Salem, NC
findings: ZIP 27107 (Winston Salem) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27107 (Winston Salem) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27107 (Winston Salem) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
